title: Roast leeks, squash and butter beans with hazelnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain cupboard staple, and tahini is on the store list as a single-ingredient paste.

supermarket.reason: Squash, leeks, tinned butter beans, hazelnuts and tahini are all everyday items at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a small bowl and basic chopping.

works.reason: A whole squash, four leeks and two tins of beans make a filling tray for four, and the staged roasting at 200°C gives sensible timings for each ingredient.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers peeling and cubing the squash, slicing leeks and garlic, and chopping nuts, and the 20+15+10 roasting matches the 45 minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears apart from water, and all names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot roasted traybake suits mid-January, and four leeks lead the title as a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English, such as 'until the leeks catch at the edges'.

hearty_healthy.reason: Vegetables, beans and nuts with a tahini dressing make a filling, balanced dinner.
